paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The effect of context masking on case tasks groupby by language family. Error bars indicate the standard deviation.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks, grouped by language family. The horizontal axis represents language family, with categories labeled “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “IE-other”, “Isolate”, “Semitic”, and “Uralic”, presented in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “effect”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5. For each language family, there are six bars representing different models: “mBERT-L₂” (light blue), “XLM-L₂” (steel blue), “mBERT-R₂” (light coral), “XLM-R₂” (dark coral), “mBERT-B₂” (forest green), and “XLM-B₂” (red). Within each language family, the bars are grouped according to model, and each bar has an error bar extending vertically from its top. The shortest bars are observed for “Isolate,” with the “mBERT-L₂” bar reaching approximately 2, while the tallest bars are found for the “Semitic” category, where the “XLM-R₂” bar extends to around 23. The bars are not sorted by height or any other visible criteria, and no bars are visibly emphasized.
